tickets.name: Win the Tip
tickets.note: Pull up a chair for Hornets at Wizards, because the first minute is where the money is! It starts with Davis against Diabate at center court, and our money says Davis gets up there first! Win that tip and the Wizards are first in line to score. The Wizards' first set runs through Sarr, and he's got the green light shining bright! The Hornets get a stop? Then it's Reid running the other way for the first two! Every one of our picks is a way to win the opening bucket, and every one of them cashes!

It's up for grabs, and we're holding a ticket on both teams! First play out of the timeout? Nope, first play of the game, and it's Collins with the ball! And if the Nets flip the script, Sharpe is waiting right there to pounce! Any of them scores first, and we're counting money!

tickets.name: Tip Drill
tickets.note: Here comes Magic at Raptors, and the opening tip is where our night begins! Carter squares up with Poeltl for the opening tip, and we like Carter to control it! No telling who scores first here, so we've got a man on each side! Give Carter the tip and he's sprinting to the block. Feed the big man! If the tip goes the Raptors' way, Poeltl is the guy we want letting it fly! Hit one, cover the game. Simple as that, folks!

tickets.name: Break the Seal

Just one play in this game, and it's Jackson all the way!
